other_conditions: At least one partner in the couple must be a native of Chhattisgarh.
Applicant must have a disability of 40% or above as per the Persons with Disabilities Act, 1995.
Marriage must be conducted according to social customs or legally solemnized by a competent court.
Applicant must not be an income taxpayer.
Application must be submitted within six months of the marriage.
The incentive amount is payable only once in a lifetime.
If the marriage is dissolved without a valid reason within five years, the incentive amount will be recovered as land revenue.
benefits_summary: Provides a lump‑sum incentive of ₹1,00,000 for a couple with one disabled partner, or ₹50,000 if both partners are disabled.
documents_required: Prescribed application form with joint signature/thumb impression
